top_stories.title: Meta releases 816B-parameter Muse Spark Open for coding and agent work
top_stories.description: Meta Platforms Inc. today released open weights for its Muse Spark artificial intelligence model, which had been proprietary since its April debut. The release, called Muse Spark Open, is built for coding and long-running agent work. Meta describes it as the most capable open-weight model to come out of a U.S. lab so far. top_stories.title: TurboMamba: Faster Inference, Faster Training, and Better Prediction with Lexical Memory
top_stories.description: arXiv:2610.20682v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce TurboMamba, a language-model architecture for faster inference, faster training, and better token prediction. A global Mamba-3 model runs once per completed token block. A small Transformer uses this global context and earlier tokens within the block to predict the next token. top_stories.description: Nvidia Corp. today announced the launch of customizable Nemotron 3.5 Super LV large language models for always-on artificial intelligence agents and edge-focused 3.5 Bolt for local systems.
